method: Local SHA-256 manifest plus targeted text extraction from the user-supplied PDFs; no PDF copied to Git or VM.

rules.evidence: Clause 3.3.4.2 states the 16.67 percent rated-power-per-minute default and inclusive adjustable range 5 to 100 percent.
Clause 3.3.4.2 applies the same default to increase and decrease and permits separate rate limits.
Table 3.6 lists Australia A VW1 as 253 V.
Table 3.7 lists Australia A VV1 as 207 V.
Amendment 2 Table 4.10 lists Australia A fURF as 50.15 Hz.
rules.discrepancy: The JSON field expected.default models the table value as a default, while Table 4.10 presents it as the upper connection and reconnection frequency. Rule data was not silently changed.

rules.evidence: Clause 4.5.4 and Table 4.8 define voltage-disturbance behavior and require compliance determination by type testing.
rules.discrepancy: The JSON unit 'type-test evidence' is an internal evidence-model abstraction, not a physical unit stated by the Standard. Rule data was not silently changed.

coverage_limit: This is a six-rule demonstration. It is not a complete transcription of AS/NZS 4777.2 and cannot support certification.
